instruction.text: This is a map of Micronesia. Select the storm to learn more.

hint.label: Typhoon
hint.text: A typhoon is a powerful storm that forms over warm, tropical ocean waters in the north-west Pacific. It brings strong winds, heavy rain and large waves.

atoms.b: In April 2026, Typhoon Sinlaku hit the Northern Mariana Islands. Its ((++wind_speeds sunshine)) increased by 75% in just over a day as it approached the region.
Sinlaku caused over $1 billion in ((++damage protection)) across the Northern Mariana Islands. Thousands of homes on Saipan, the largest island, still had no power months later.
In response, the Northern Mariana Islands are working with US agencies to build homes with ((++stronger weaker)) roofs, storm shutters and wind-resistant windows.

trainers.instruction: Listen and select the correct statement.

b.sound: An atoll is a ring-shaped island with a coral rim that encircles a lagoon.
An atoll is a square-shaped island with a metal rim that encircles a building.
Kiribass is home to more atolls than any other country, including the world’s largest.
Kiribass is home to more waterfalls than any other country, including the world’s largest.
Unfortunately, atoll communities are vulnerable to flooding, coastal erosion and contaminated freshwater.
Unfortunately, atoll communities are vulnerable to heavy snowfall, avalanches and glacier formations.

atoms.b: Upon entry to Palau, visitors must have their passports stamped with a signed Palau Pledge. Written by local children, this pledge calls on visitors to ((++protect destroy)) the islands’ environment and culture for future generations.

In 2022, Palau also introduced a unique eco-tourism initiative called Ol’au Palau. In exchange for environmentally ((++friendly harmful)) choices, visitors earn points in an app and can unlock special experiences.
atoms.sound: In 2022, Palau also introduced a unique eco tourism initiative called Ohlau Palau. In exchange for environmentally friendly choices, visitors earn points in an app and can unlock special experiences.

atoms.b: Some of these eco-friendly measures include ((++avoiding using)) single-use plastics, eating local sustainable foods and using reef-safe sunscreen.

instruction.text: Drag the boat along its route across the Pacific Ocean.
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Micronesia has a long history of Pacific navigation. Early voyagers sailed from modern-day South-East Asia, mainly the Philippines, to settle on the Mariana Islands in Western Micronesia.
These sailors used traditional navigation techniques, such as following the stars, charting wind and wave patterns and observing the flight paths of birds.

Navigators often travelled on wa, ancient Micronesian sailing canoes from the Caroline Islands. Built from breadfruit tree trunks, these boats enabled travel, trade and settlement across thousands of Pacific islands.
atoms.sound: Navigators often travelled on waaa, ancient Micronesian sailing canoes from the Caroline Islands. Built from breadfruit tree-trunks, these boats enabled travel, trade and settlement across thousands of Pacific islands.
